system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
Each agent is a self-contained markdown playbook (`## User Prompt` methodology +
`## System Prompt` strict anti-false-positive rules).
system_prompt_style.note: System prompt assembled from the selected agent markdown files plus objective/out-of-scope which 'steer every agent prompt'.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
before the model recon, the harness runs a
**real** request/response analysis (status/redirects, security headers, cookie
flags, CORS reflection, tech fingerprint, linked JS, 404 baseline, high-signal
paths) and feeds those observed facts into recon
env_context_strategy.note: Deterministic probe injects facts and agents also navigate with curl/nmap tools.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
agents capture visual proof per finding
(`evidence/<finding-id>-N.png`), embedded beside its vulnerability
observation_format.note: Empirical raw tool output receipts plus proof screenshots.

tool_call_format.note: Agents drive shell CLIs (curl/nmap/aws/gcloud); no parser code available in evidence.

edit_primitive.note: Agents write PoC scripts to pocs/ but no file-edit tool is documented.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Enable Playwright MCP (auto-provisioned via `npx`; backends without MCP use built-in tools).

loop_primitives.note: Fixed staged pipeline; cross-model voting across parallel agents supports multi_attempt: 'validates every claim by cross-model voting'.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote:
a property-graph **belief** carries probabilities,
and "scan more vs exploit now" falls out of belief entropy
planning_granularity.note: POMDP belief property-graph maintained as a structured object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
intelligently selects only the agents that match the
discovered surface**, runs them in parallel
multi_agent_topology.note: orchestrator.md meta-agent selects and runs specialist agents.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote:
runs them in parallel, **chains** findings into deeper
impact

human_in_loop.note: TUI composer also allows live steering (pause) during a run.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote:
`<cwd>/.neurosploit/` keeps session, run history and
command history; the REPL **resumes** on reopen
long_term_memory.note: RL reward store data/rl_state_rs.json biases selection on future runs.

state_persistence.note: Also web run reattaches to same live stream.

self_verification.evidence_quote:
a different model adjudicates each finding;
RL-weighted, recon-aware agent selection
self_verification.note: Cross-model validation vote + LLM-judge loop for AI red-team.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: recon → select → parallel exploitation → cross-model validation vote

termination_condition.evidence_quote: `--max-agents N` | Cap agents run (`0` = all matching the recon).
termination_condition.note: Pipeline ends at report (model_declared); --max-agents caps work.

cost_controls.note: Telemetry only; no explicit budget/cache/cost-routing documented.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote:
every action spawns the real compiled CLI and parses its
output
execution_isolation.note: Runs on host (Kali recommended); Kali Docker image is an option.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote:
**Recommended: run on Kali Linux** (or the
Kali Docker image) so the offensive tools the agents use are already present
filesystem_access.note: Full access to host filesystem within boundary.

network_policy.evidence_quote:
routes agent traffic
through your local intercepting proxy
network_policy.note: Network pentesting tool with unrestricted egress to targets.

permission_model.evidence_quote:
Agents are instructed to stay in scope, never run
destructive/DoS actions, and require proof-of-exploitation.
permission_model.note: Scope/out-of-scope steering is prompt-level, not an execution allowlist.

tracing.note: Per-run folder with status.json, recon.json, findings.json.

replayability.note: role_replay_attack_specialist.md agent present; resume supported, no deterministic guarantee.

eval_hooks.note: Offline is a pipeline self-test, not a benchmark evaluation harness.

guardrails.evidence_quote:
all
under a strict **data-safety/PII guardrail** (no destructive/state-changing
actions; PII proven with a masked sample, never dumped).

target_domain.evidence_quote: an advanced, AI-powered penetration testing framework designed to automate and augment various aspects of offensive security operations.
target_domain.note: Penetration testing (other) with web/browser targets, AI red-team, and MCP general tool use.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote:
drives a **pool of
LLMs** — via **API key** or local **subscription**

first_release_date.note: Only available tag v4.0.0 date used as basis.

stars.note: Star count only shown via dynamic badge.
